# Track `r2-jazan`: status

Label: screening input, not a forecast.

**Outputs:** `cities/ksa/regions/jazan.parquet` and `.csv` (50 rows, same ids and values), `docs/regions/jazan.md` (generated by the builder), `docs/assumptions-r2-jazan.md` (8 rows, `A-jazan-001..008`), `docs/sources/r2-jazan.csv` (1 new row, `S-jazan-016`), scripts in `screening/sweeps/jazan/` (`build_register.py`, `geo_estimates.py`).

**Governorates:** `governorates_gastat: 17` (derived, A-jazan-003: the 17 working-list names are all in GASTAT's primary governorate export, S-cp2-gastat-007; their totals sum to the Jazan region total 1,404,997, S-cp2-gastat-001). `governorates_listed: 17` (citypopulation.de, S-jazan-001). **Conflict kept open:** Saudipedia says 16 (S-jazan-003). GASTAT's own list was not read (portal.saudicensus.sa unreachable, S-jazan-015), so the 17 is derived from the primary export, not read from a GASTAT list.

**Rows:** 50 = 17 centres + 33 places at or above 5,000 on the figure used. `tag_10k`: 12. `tag_5k`: 46. Population types: official 26 (GASTAT primary city export 25, citypopulation relayed 1 for Al Tuwal), derived 2 (OSM population tags, secondary), grid 20 (WorldPop 2020, unverified), none 2 (Al Harth and Fayfa centres).

**Population rule applied:** GASTAT primary first (S-cp2-gastat-008: every official value is checked against the export). One override: Alkhadra' takes the GASTAT figure 5,861 over R1a's WorldPop 7,055 (+20.4 %; A-jazan-005). Grid rows are not corroborated (no second method run), so the only grid row at or above 10,000 (Al Jawah, 21,104) is `tag_10k: false` with `grid-only population, uncorroborated`. No corroboration value is set anywhere.

**Roles sourced:** 25 role entries on the 17 centres, each with an S- source: Jizan (airport, port, industrial city, university, energy: the Jazan refinery, S-jazan-016), Farasan (tourism, heritage), Samtah (agriculture, snippet only, A-jazan-006), and administrative on every centre (S-jazan-001). No border-crossing, hajj/umrah, military, mining or giga-project role is sourced for Jazan; none assigned.

**Distances:** existing = Haramain station Makkah (S-jazan-008), committed = Landbridge (committed layer, status announced; S-054), metro = R1a's nearest metro city and tier (A-screen-013). Road minutes from R1a's OSRM skims (S-r1a-809, free-flow car, uncalibrated); `dist_method: haversine`, checked against R1a's fields to within 0.5 km (asserted). No committed or hypothetical line is labelled existing.

**Terrain:** rule-based (A-jazan-002), not DEM. DEM classes are still needed.

**GEO_VERIFY:** `screening.geo_verify.cli estimate` reads only `cities/ksa/regions/pilot-*.parquet` (`screening/geo_verify/cli.py:35`), so it cannot reach the R2 register. I ran the same `estimate_one` through `screening/sweeps/jazan/geo_estimates.py` for the 25 rows that are unverified, relayed or unpopulated (seed 1, back-test summary from the main checkout, 0 downloads). Outputs are in `runs/geo_verify/estimate-r2-jazan/` (gitignored). Estimates are in `notes` only. 19 of 25 produced an estimate; 6 had no building cluster in the window (n = 0: Ar Rayth, Faifa, Harub, Al Jawah, Muqza`, Al Kadarah), recorded as no estimate. The back-test gate still fails (median APE grid 0.667, buildings 0.595), so no estimate enters `population`. To make the CLI cover R2, `REGISTERS` in `screening/geo_verify/cli.py` would need to include `jazan.parquet`; that file is outside this track and was not changed.

**Inputs linked, not copied:** `data/ksa/grids` and `data/ksa/geo` are symlinks to the main checkout's data (gitignored). No new download, so `cities/ksa/sources.yaml` and the licence register need no new rows; OSM, GASTAT and WorldPop rows already cover every input.
